title: CASTLE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Student-Tailored Personalized Safety in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to queries containing stereotypes or discriminatory views (e.g., gender suitability for certain academic majors) paired with specific student profiles, scored by LLM evaluators on risk sensitivity, emotional empathy, and user-specific alignment.

Testing models with personalized educational scenarios where AI interactions might induce negative self-cognitive biases in students, measuring the model's ability to identify the risk, demonstrate empathy, and safely align with the student's psychological profile.
